strategy.name: Wyckoff_Accumulation_Markup_VolConfirm
strategy.rationale: Technicals-only equity swing on MTF. Buys stocks that are in Wyckoff accumulation turning to markup, above the 200-DMA, with volume confirming price and a nearest-resistance/nearest-support reward:risk of at least 1.8. Sizing is off the technical stop below support; the 5-day cap is hard because MTF interest turns a slow winner into a loser. No fundamentals — this desk was deliberately scoped to what can be computed from price and volume alone, rather than pretending to read financials it cannot reach.

journal.headline: TITAN -> SKIP (0.78)
journal.detail:
BULL: TITAN is above both 200DMA (4132) and 50DMA (4352), confirming a structurally healthy uptrend. Wyckoff phase reads markup with volume confirming — price is being absorbed by buyers. RSI at 65.97 is elevated but not yet overbought; there is room to run to resistance before exhaustion signals appear. The reward:risk ratio of 3.12 to nearest levels (support 4700, resistance 4733) sounds tight in abso

BEAR: The geometry here is brutal. Resistance is only 0.53% away (4733) and the breakeven including MTF interest over 5 days is 0.36%. That means the stock needs to clear 4733 convincingly AND push toward 4800 just to make this trade worthwhile — a >1.9% move from current price — all within 5 sessions.
